bias.label: Leaning down below 4,088 into the weekend

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST. The market closes for the weekend at midnight SAST, so watch for a gap at Monday's open.

bullets.title: Jobs beat big
bullets.text: US payrolls rose 165,000 in October against about 65,000 expected, unemployment fell to 4.1% and wages rose 0.4% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Gold off lows
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,063 at 21:59 SAST, down about 0.6% on the day, after an earlier low near 4,033.

bullets.title: Dollar stronger
bullets.text: The dollar index rose about 0.7% to near 102.3 and the 10-year yield is near 4.87% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Fed sounds hawkish
bullets.text: Fed's Daly said on Friday afternoon that more rate hikes are needed, and December hike odds were about 80% on Thursday (CME, via Trading Economics); Friday's number is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Still a strong week
bullets.text: Gold is still up about 4.6% this week, so buyers have not left (150currency, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Below the averages
bullets.text: Gold sits below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, so the bigger trend is still down (Gold Stock Canada).

buy.title: Buy plan: counter-trend bounce at 4,022

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 4,022-4,033, after a sweep below 4,022 and a reclaim

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down after the jobs beat, so use half size or skip it.
A dip under 4,022 that closes back above it on the 15M: your reclaim candle.
The dollar index slipping back under 102.
Wait for Monday's open to settle before acting on any gap.
watch: Strong jobs data and higher hike odds favour sellers. You are fighting the move.
A weekend headline (Iran, Hormuz) can gap price either way on Monday.
Buying Friday's last hour with thin liquidity and wider spreads.
Moving your stop lower when it gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: rejection under 4,088
look: A bounce into 4,075-4,088 that stalls with a 15M rejection wick or bearish close.
The dollar index holding above 102 and the 2-year yield firm.
A 1H close below 4,033 adds weight, with 4,022 next.
Hot CPI on Tuesday 15:30 SAST would support the sell case; wait for it to print.
watch: Gold is still up about 4.6% this week, so dip buyers can step in hard.
Selling low near 4,033-4,063 with no level to lean on.
A soft CPI on Tuesday can push gold back through 4,100.
